title: Nutty American Sweet Potato Casserole
description: A festive American dish featuring sweet potatoes, juniper berries, and lardons, perfect for the holidays, and is egg-free-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large pot, boil the sweet potatoes until they are tender, then drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, render the lardons over medium heat until crispy, then set aside.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked sweet potatoes, crushed juniper berries, brown sugar, salt, black pepper, and cinnamon, and mix until well combined.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, arrange half of the sweet potato mixture in the bottom of the dish.
Top the sweet potatoes with the rendered lardons and half of the chopped pecans.
Repeat the layers, starting with the remaining sweet potato mixture, then the remaining pecans, and finally the miniature marshmallows.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the marshmallows are golden brown.
